correctness.rationale: Algorithm 2 permits the exact local unconstrained line search because all positive barycentric weights make alpha=0 a strictly interior feasible step. The derivative is I-n_i n_i^T H/(n_i^T H n_i). Conjugating by H^{1/2} makes each a rank-one orthogonal projector; direct product gives the exact operator norm, trace, zero determinant and square identity. Nonparallel rays forbid multiple orthogonal vertex pairs. All three geometric cases follow exhaustively; analyticity gives the one-/two-sweep quadratic estimates. The H-metric Thales-circle locus is a direct quadratic identity and a disk convexity argument. A standalone verifier runs 1840 exact symbolic/rational assertions, including genuine clipped feasible steps and Taylor coefficients. Finite tests are not used to certify the universal statements.

value.rationale: The source PolyCDwA has a proven global linear bound. This classification identifies an exact natural subfamily with dramatically stronger local rate, distinguishes whether one or two sweeps must be grouped despite the same zero linearized spectral radius, and produces a complete geometric locus for when it occurs in arbitrary SPD triangles. The strict interior target and metric-circle geometry motivate the precise invariant; the away-step versus forward-only example identifies a mechanism relevant to vertex-based optimization algorithms. It is a nongeneric, local classification, not a generic convergence speedup or a routine finite table.
